scope: libvapor_exec.so LD_PRELOAD exec shim for a future target SDK > 28; packaged, not preloaded.
device: VaporProbe36A, Android 16/API 36, 4 KB pages; app built at targetSdk 35 and 28 via temporary local edits (shipped target stays 28)
bugs_found_and_fixed_during_measurement: linker64 rejects relative program paths ("expected absolute path"): shim joins relative paths to the cwd without resolving symlinks
wineserver located its NLS data via /proc/self/exe, which named the linker: shim emulates /proc/self/exe via VAPOR_EXEC_SELF
fortified call inside __readlinkat_chk resolved back to itself (infinite loop): shim built with -U_FORTIFY_SOURCE and wrappers call private helpers

wine_probe.note: run-as runs in runas_app, which W^X does not restrict; used only as the direct-exec baseline. All target-35 results come from the app process (instrumentation).

target35_with_shim.wineserver NLS: loads (failed before /proc/self/exe emulation: "failed to load l_intl.nls")
target35_with_shim.wine cmd /c echo: could not load kernel32.dll, status c0000135 (same as direct-exec baseline)

wine_probe.WINEDATADIR: does not affect wineserver NLS lookup (tested)

limitations: Not preloaded by any launcher yet; shipped target stays 28.
posix_spawn reroute is implemented but not exercised by a test (sh/env use execve/execvp).
Full game launch at target 35 needs the shim wired into GuestProgramLauncherComponent with a prepared container; the ad-hoc staging stops at kernel32.dll in both modes.
